record.title: Microchip MCP73213 — dual-cell (2S, 8.2/8.4/8.7/8.8 V) Li-ion / Li-polymer linear charge management controller with input over-voltage protection, DFN-10 3x3
record.why: IDENTITY READ OFF THE VENDOR'S OWN DOCUMENT. datasheet.pdf is Microchip's DS20002190D fetched 2026-09-02 from ww1.microchip.com (HTTP 200, 788319 bytes, sha256 in PROVENANCE.json); its page footer prints verbatim '2009-2018 Microchip Technology Inc.' and 'DS20002190D-page 1'. NOTE THE TRAP THIS LANE HIT: the first Microchip PDF the search surfaced (DS51849A, 51849a.pdf) is the MCP73213 EVALUATION-BOARD user's guide, not the chip datasheet; it was discarded. Every figure in electrical.chip.json is quoted from DS20002190D. WHAT THIS FOLDER IS: the REFERENCE 2S charger IC for a Microduck rebuild (GOAL.md rung 4). Pollen's product charges the NP-F550 in an external 'Dual Battery Charger' whose specs are CANNOT DETERMINE (docs/ELECTRONICS-AND-SOFTWARE.md §9), and whether the robot charges in situ over USB-C is CANNOT DETERMINE. PASS means the part is exactly identified and its sheet is on the shelf; it does not claim the part is fitted.
record.subsector_why: open vocabulary; the sheet's own words are 'Battery Charge Management Controller'.
record.lifecycle_why: no page fetched states a lifecycle; DS20002190D is dated 2009-2018.
record.origin_why: the manufacturer's own datasheet PDF was FETCHED from ww1.microchip.com and saved byte for byte as datasheet.pdf; PROVENANCE.json carries its sha256, size and URL. A second vendor sheet (Analog Devices LTC4002, 4002f.pdf, a 2-cell SWITCH-MODE alternative) is saved under docs/ with its own provenance row; it is an alternative, not a second source for these figures.
record.used_by_why: no ce-elec board in this design names it yet.
